reply.text: That is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, and I won't read anything into the stairs pattern for you. Get the knee looked at by someone who can examine it. Once they've cleared you, tell me what you're allowed to do and I'll build training around it, keeping the knee-loading work to what they say is fine. Meanwhile, if you want, we can look at how your lower-body training has been going so we're not guessing about it later.
